name: Ludwig von Cadence
source:
Likes: Heroes
Dislikes: Bullies

Ludwig von Cadence is the richest man in town. He's a huge supporter of the Church and Father Thompson's doings. He admires heroes and wishes to be one too. He's on a search for his wife, his disappeared so many years ago.
